pr_title: executor: fix the error that is raised when executing the window function with range type frame
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

When executing window function with range type frame, tidb needs to compare the result of `CalFunc` and `order by column`. Sometimes, CalFunc returns decimal type while `order by column` is an int column. In this circumstance, tidb will get the value of `order by column` with decimal type which it's an int column, which result the raised error.

issue_context.title: Window function raises error when executing with range frame
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

```
drop table if exists test.first_range;
create table test.first_range(p int not null, o int not null, v int not null);
insert into test.first_range (p, o, v) values (0, 0, 0), (1, 1, 1), (1, 2, 2), (1, 4, 4), (1, 8, 8), (2, 0, 0), (2, 3, 3), (2, 10, 10), (2, 13, 13), (2, 15, 15), (3, 1, 1), (3, 3, 3), (3, 5, 5), (3, 9, 9), (3, 15, 15), (3, 20, 20), (3, 31, 31);
select *, first_value(v) over (partition by p order by o range between 3 preceding and 2.9 following) as a from test.first_range;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Return results

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

It raises error: ERROR 1105 (HY000): runtime error: index out of range [40] with length 40

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

nightly c0c54f23b350e0d7c56215

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
